archetype.name: User-submitted task
archetype.description: A task submitted explicitly by a user without requiring authorizations.
archetype.documentation:
This archetype denotes a task submitted explicitly by a user without any authorizations. This means that all expressions should run under ##currentPrincipal expression profile.
This is to allow the superuser to run trusted code, even if the standard profile for single-run action tasks has less trusted profile. And vice versa, it blocks unprivileged users from running dangerous code, even if the standard profile for single-run action tasks has more trusted profile.
